card.name: Digits inside long year or ID numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, often 1, partway through a multi-digit number such as a year range, a date in a citation, or an ID. Most often seen in birth-death years of authors and in reference numbers.

modes.label: Year ranges
modes.description: A digit in the second year of a span, such as a birth-death or restoration range.
